ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - WinPwn Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects commandline keywords indicative of potential usge of the tool WinPwn. A tool for Windows and Active Directory reconnaissance and exploitation.

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*Offline\\_Winpwn.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*WinPwn\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*WinPwn\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*WinPwn\\\.ps1.*"))
